name: Butcher Shop / Deli
description: Specialty butcher counter and artisan delicatessen offering premium raw meats priced by weight, house-marinated cuts, handcrafted charcuterie, artisanal cheeses, gourmet deli sandwiches, prepared sides, and custom grazing boards. Features weight-based catch-weight pricing, custom cut thickness, bone and skin tailoring, and advance holiday order reservations.

sections.name: Fresh Cuts — Beef
sections.description: Hand-selected, prime, and dry-aged whole carcass beef cuts processed on-site by skilled butchers. Sourced from grass-fed and grain-finished cattle, this core butcher section features steaks, oven-ready roasts, freshly ground minces, and rich soup bones customized by portion weight, cut thickness, and fat trimming preference.

subSections.name: Steaks & Premium Cuts
subSections.description: Prime marbled steaks including ribeye, striploin, tenderloin filet, T-bone, and flat iron sliced to thickness.

subSections.name: Roasts & Joints
subSections.description: Oven-ready beef joints including standing prime rib, rolled brisket, chuck pot roasts, and eye of round.

subSections.name: Ground & Minced
subSections.description: Coarse and fine ground beef ground fresh daily in calibrated lean-to-fat ratios (80/20, 85/15, and 90/10).

subSections.name: Bones & Offal
subSections.description: Gelatin-rich marrow bones, soup bones, oxtails, beef cheeks, liver, and tongue for stocks, broths, and traditional cooking.

subSections.description: Whole roasting chickens, free-range heritage birds, capons, roasting ducks, and whole turkeys ready for oven or spit.

subSections.name: Breast & Fillet

subSections.name: Thigh & Drumstick

subSections.name: Wings
subSections.description: Whole three-joint chicken wings, separated party flats (wingettes), and meaty drumettes for grilling or frying.

itemOptions.label: Special Butchery Notes & Custom Cut Instructions

systemFeatures.name: Weight-Based & Catch-Weight Pricing
systemFeatures.description: Fundamental butcher pricing engine supporting variable catch-weight billing, price per 100g/250g/500g/1kg/lb, real-time scale tare deduction, and estimated versus final scale weigh-in totals on customer receipts.

systemFeatures.name: Advance Pre-Order & Holiday Reservations
systemFeatures.description: Enables customers to schedule advance pickup orders for holiday roasts, custom-butchered primals, cured deli party platters, and BBQ packages with configurable lead times and daily cutoff windows.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Indicators
systemFeatures.description: Highlights common food allergens (dairy, gluten, nuts, soy, sulfites, mustard, celery) and dietary credentials (halal, kosher, grass-fed, pasture-raised, nitrite-free, organic) across all fresh meats, marinades, charcuterie, cheeses, and deli sandwiches.

systemFeatures.name: Counter & Display Case Inventory Badges
systemFeatures.description: Displays real-time case availability badges, dry-age day counters, limited-cut warnings, morning-arrival fresh indicators, and sold-out notifications to manage customer expectations at the butcher and deli counters.

systemFeatures.name: Storage & Safe Meat Handling Instructions
systemFeatures.description: Provides comprehensive cold-chain storage instructions, recommended refrigeration durations, safe freezing and thawing protocols, and safe internal cooking temperature guides on product pages and digital receipts.
